drums.description: Industrial techno with heavy distortion and noise elements, A distorted, overdriven kick drum hits on every quarter note with a long, saturated sub-bass tail, A high-frequency white noise riser sweeps upward over four bars, A metallic, percussive synth hit with short decay triggers on the off-beats, A resonant, low-pass filtered synth sequence cycles through a repetitive four-note pattern, The track features a constant layer of static and vinyl crackle, Tempo is 135 BPM in the key of C minor, 4/4 time signature, High-pass filters are applied to the percussion during the build-up phase, Heavy sidechain compression causes the noise floor to pump in sync with the kick drum Publish

bass.description: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences, A distorted, overdriven kick drum drives the rhythm at 130 BPM in 4/4 time, A resonant, acid-style monophonic synth bassline plays a repetitive sixteenth-note pattern with frequent low-pass filter modulation, Metallic, industrial percussion hits occur on the off-beats, processed with short plate reverb, A high-pitched, dissonant synth lead enters with a rhythmic gate effect, creating a stuttering texture, The track features a dark, aggressive sound palette with bit-crushed textures and saturated transients, Key is C minor Publish
